label: Server type
source: Swayam's A100 or H100 switch, added in v0.5
note: a100_8x or h100_8x. Swaps the default numbers for power, rental price, resale, parts value and part cost. Anything typed in still wins

label: GPUs per server
source: NVIDIA DGX H100 user guide: 32 DIMMs, 8 U.2 + 2 M.2 drives, 8+2 ConnectX-7, 2x Xeon 8480C, 10.2 kW max, 287.6 lb
note: Reference server is an 8x A100 system

label: Server power draw
source: DGX A100 6.5 kW max; DGX H100 10.2 kW max (NVIDIA user guides)
note: Maximum, not average. DGX H100 peaks above 10 kW

label: Ownership
source: owned, client_approved or consigned. Consigned servers cannot be rented out

label: Selling fees
source: eBay final value fee 13.6% as the public-marketplace cost of a sale . Higher bound: ITAD consignment keeps 20-40%

label: Resale price decline while waiting
source: Price Build: H100 value curve, year 3 to 4

label: Expected days until a buyer appears
note: Midpoint of range. Stress cases use 45 and 70

label: Rental price per GPU-hour
source: Silicon Data rental indices: SDA100RT $1.57, SDH100RT $2.72 (Sep 28 2026, locked). Latest Oct 1 2026: H100 $2.77, A100 $1.58. Index moves daily; read the live headline, not the FAQ text
note: Neo-cloud benchmark. Other reads: BofA $1.65 (Aug 2026), AIMultiple median $1.76 (Sep 2026)

label: Marketplace cut
note: On Vast.ai hosts earn their set price; ask in host interview

label: Steady-state utilization
note: Enterprise cards 60 to 70% at steady state

label: First-month utilization
note: New providers 30 to 40% in month one

label: Days from racked to earning
source: Regional move 1-2 business days + 1 day rack and test

label: Days to drain, wipe, ship
source: 1 day drain rental jobs + 1 day wipe and de-rack + 1 day carrier pickup; fits inside the delivery window

label: Electricity
note: Commercial rates are higher, around 13 cents

label: Colo fee per kW per month
note: Electricity billed on top. GPU colo quotes $130 to $300 all-in (GYGO). Single-server retail may cost more

label: Maintenance reserve
source: Price Build: incidents x hours x technician rate

label: Activation (move, rack, set up)
source: Price Build: freight in + install hours

label: Monthly decline in rent and resale
note: Low 0% (A100 index rose $1.40 Feb to $1.57 Sep 2026). High 2.7% (H100 index fell 23% Sep 2024 to Jun 2025, its sharpest correction)

label: Annual discount rate
source: Damodaran cost of capital, Jan 2026: Computers/Peripherals 9.71%

label: Harvest value (net)
source: Price Build: 7 working GPUs + parts, net

label: Repair labor
source: Team value (4 hrs at $150/hr sourced rate = $600)
note: Remote hands run about $75 to $150 per hour

label: Days out of market while repairing
